## Education

::: {.timeline}
::: {.tl-item}
[2025 – 2026]{.when}

### MSc Bioinformatics, University of Birmingham (Dubai)

**Thesis:** Detecting potato late blight from UAV multispectral imagery across ~280 varieties,
with variety-grouped validation, permutation tests and SNP-data fusion.
[Read the project →](projects/potato-late-blight/)
:::
:::

## Research & projects

::: {.timeline}
::: {.tl-item}
[2026 – now]{.when}

### Late-blight evaluation paper (in preparation)

Turning the thesis into an evaluation study: a stricter held-out-variety test, confidence
intervals that resample whole varieties, and a CNN feasibility test on plot images.
:::
::: {.tl-item}
[2026]{.when}

### rushtools: R & Python packages

Personal function libraries with testthat and pytest suites, run automatically by GitHub Actions.
[More →](projects/rushtools/)
:::
::: {.tl-item}
[2026]{.when}

### Paper reproduction labs

Re-did published analyses from scratch: Palmer penguins, potato GWAS, RNA-seq (airway) and
disease text mining. [More →](projects/paper-reproductions/)
:::
:::
